resources.string: No account with us, no ads

No account with us, no ads, no usage tracking.

Your settings, photos, notes and backups stay on this TV, or in an account of your own if you connect one.

The TV only talks to the services you turn on, such as the weather or movie posters. Some go through our server (api.sofaly.tv), such as podcast search; it only gets the request, never an account of yours. The privacy policy on the site lists each one.
